About the Team 
 DoorDash's mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about – helping grow business and the communities that support those businesses.
 About the Role 
 We’re looking for a business-savvy operator with a strong bias toward action to lead DoorDash Canada’s expansion and marketplace performance. As the national expansion lead, you’ll blend strategic thinking with operational excellence to identify growth opportunities, build strong internal partnerships, and improve customer and merchant experiences across the country.
 This role requires a proactive self-starter who thrives at the intersection of data, process management, and execution. Whether analyzing performance metrics for a new launch or engaging with cross-functional partners, you’ll uncover ways to improve market performance. Expansion is core to DoorDash Canada's growth, and we need someone who can apply best practices and right-size them for local geographies to ensure we are building a lasting product for our customers.
 We’re seeking someone who’s data-driven, a hands-on operator, relationship-oriented, and eager to make a tangible impact by positioning DoorDash as Canada's top platform.
 You’re excited about this opportunity because you will… 
 Own and execute the Canada expansion strategy : Build and execute a national roadmap focused on increasing our footprint while ensuring launch markets perform to expectations through rigorous marketplace management.
 Tactically run end-to-end execution : Lead the expansion lifecycle from initial strategy and buy-in through to execution, ensuring every launch is set up for long-term success.
 Right-size best practices : Apply proven operational frameworks while localizing strategies based on the specific marketplace dynamics of diverse Canadian cities.
 Lead cross-functional collaboration : Act as the connective tissue between the expansion team and DoorDash’s commercial units, surfacing insights and co-developing strategies that support national growth.
 Build strong internal relationships : Partner effectively with stakeholders across Dasher, Sales, Merchant, and Marketing teams to ensure a unified approach to marketplace health.
 Act like an Owner : Take full ownership of the success of our growth markets, with the autonomy to test, iterate, and scale what works across the country
 We’re excited about you because you have… 
 Are a builder and connector : You see opportunities where others see roadblocks. You’re energized by building systems from the ground up and forming lasting relationships along the way
 Have an operational mindset : You understand how to identify, scope, and execute high-impact initiatives, and you know how to align internal stakeholders to get things done.
 Thrive in ambiguity and autonomy : You’re comfortable setting your own direction, testing and learning as you go, and staying laser-focused on outcomes.
 Are operationally sharp and analytically driven : You turn insights into action and know how to measure and report on impact in a fast-moving environment.
 Qualifications 
 4+ years of experience in business development, consulting, strategy, startups, or operations
 Demonstrated experience working cross-functionally with commercial teams 
 Proven ability to identify growth opportunities and lead strategic initiatives from conception to execution
 Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence across various stakeholders and levels of the organization
 Proficient in Excel/Google Sheets and SQL; comfortable making decisions grounded in data
 Compensation 
 Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location. 
 In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.
 DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package for all regular employees, that includes paid time off, paid parental leave, wellness benefit and several paid holidays.
 Additionally, for full-time employees, DoorDash offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, disability and basic life insurance, an RRSP including an employer match, and a mental health program, among others.
 To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here .
 The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographical market up to our highest geographical market within British Columbia.
 $116,000 — $145,000 CAD 
 About DoorDash 
 At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
 DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. 
 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 
 We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 
 If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.
 Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

You’ll join a collaborative, values-driven workplace where people care about one another, meaningful work matters and you have opportunities to learn, contribute and grow. Here, you can bring your experience and ideas to the table, build strong relationships and continue developing throughout your career.

 THE POSITION 
 Keyera is currently seeking a Maintenance Coordinator to support our Fort Saskatchewan Fractionation Facility in Fort Saskatchewan, Alberta.
 This is a hands-on role responsible for coordinating day-to-day maintenance activities across multiple trades, ensuring work is safely planned, organized, and executed. Working closely with Operations, Engineering, Planning and Scheduling, and maintenance service providers, the Maintenance Coordinator will support equipment troubleshooting, preventative maintenance, maintenance projects, turnarounds, and Management of Change (MOC) activities.
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Coordinate day-to-day on-site maintenance activities across multiple trades, ensuring work is planned and executed safely in accordance with Keyera's Safe Work Practices.
 Work closely with Operations and Planning and Scheduling to coordinate maintenance execution, including permits, equipment outages, safety requirements, and work schedules.
 Assist with and lead troubleshooting activities when facility equipment is down, working with Operations and Engineering to address equipment issues and process upsets.
 Coordinate and oversee on-site maintenance service providers, including the execution of maintenance work and supporting activities.
 Manage the execution of small and large maintenance projects, including coordination of construction activities.
 Support turnaround activities and Management of Change (MOC) processes associated with maintenance and project work.
 Develop and update maintenance procedures and preventative maintenance plans.
 Collaborate with Engineering and Operations on facility designs, equipment issues, and process upsets.
 Coordinate maintenance work orders through Maximo, including creating, updating, and closing work orders.
 Lead and participate in pre-job and morning maintenance meetings.
 Assist with procurement of materials, tools, and service providers, and manage parts and consumable inventories.
 Support facility shipping, receiving, and warehouse operations.
 QUALIFICATIONS 
 5+ years of experience in a maintenance coordination role within an industrial operating environment, including hands-on field coordination of maintenance activities.
 Journeyperson Pipefitter, Millwright, or other relevant trade certifications are considered a strong asset
 Experience using Maximo or a comparable computerized maintenance management system (CMMS).
 Experience coordinating maintenance activities across multiple trades and disciplines, including project support and field execution.
 Experience supporting Management of Change (MOC) processes and turnaround activities.
 Familiarity with asset management work processes is considered an asset.
 Demonstrated ability to coordinate and prioritize multiple activities in a dynamic operating environment.
 Strong commitment to safe work practices and maintaining a safe working environment.

Nov 1, 2026

Chez Tecsys, le logiciel que nous livrons permet aux hôpitaux, pharmacies et distributeurs d'avoir ce dont ils ont besoin, quand ils en ont besoin. Chaque rôle ici contribue à ce résultat.
 Pourquoi ce rôle est important 
 En tant que ingénieur fiabilité des infrastructures, vous vous joindrez à notre Centre des opérations réseau et de sécurité (NOC), une équipe au cœur de la fiabilité des plateformes pour les environnements SaaS critiques. Vous aiderez à maintenir, optimiser et assurer la fiabilité et la performance des systèmes qui alimentent notre infrastructure infonuagique sur AWS et Kubernetes, avec un fort accent sur l’automatisation, l’observabilité et l’amélioration continue.
 Ce poste combine l’ingénierie de la fiabilité avec la gestion des incidents, vous donnant une véritable responsabilité sur la disponibilité, la performance et l’innovation. Vous ferez partie d’une équipe hautement qualifiée qui valorise la résolution créative de problèmes, l’excellence opérationnelle et l’amélioration continue grâce à l’automatisation et à l’ingénierie de la résilience.
 Ce à quoi vous participerez 
 Tecsys est reconnue par des organisations essentielles des secteurs de la santé et de la distribution pour soutenir des chaînes d'approvisionnement résilientes, efficaces et sécurisées. Nous sommes un fournisseur mondial de logiciels infonuagiques propulsés par l'Intelligence artificielle (IA), coté à la Bourse de Toronto (TSX: TCS).
 Trois valeurs guident notre façon de travailler . Nous gagnons la confiance au quotidien en valorisant le client et en agissant avec intégrité. Nous nous entraidons en reconnaissant les forces individuelles et en travaillant en équipe. Et nous explorons avec audace en restant curieux et en nous adaptant pour réussir.
 Vous vous joindrez à une culture axée sur la curiosité, l'apprentissage continu et des gens qui repoussent les limites du possible.
 Ce que vous ferez 
 Collaborer avec d’autres équipes d’ingénierie pour soutenir les services avant leur mise en service à travers des activités telles que la consultation en conception de systèmes, le développement de plateformes et de cadres logiciels, la planification des capacités et les revues de lancement. 
 Innover continuellement en identifiant les points faibles, en proposant des solutions créatives et en menant des initiatives qui simplifient, font évoluer et renforcent la plateforme. 
 Maintenir les services une fois qu’ils sont en ligne en mesurant et en surveillant la disponibilité, la latence et l’état général du système. 
 Assurer une observabilité optimisée : améliorer et élargir la surveillance et l’alerte à l’aide de Datadog; définir les SLO/SLI et créer des tableaux de bord exploitables qui génèrent des résultats de fiabilité. 
 Développer et favoriser l’automatisation : améliorer les outils internes, les cadres IaC et les pipelines (Terraform, GitLab CI/CD) afin de réduire les interventions manuelles et permettre des systèmes d’auto-réparation. 
 Faire évoluer les systèmes de façon durable par l’automatisation et en favorisant des changements qui améliorent la fiabilité et la rapidité. 
 Mettre en pratique une gestion durable des incidents et des analyses post-incident sans reproche. Diriger les examens post-incident (RCA) et identifier les correctifs à long terme qui améliorent la stabilité, la fiabilité et l’expérience des développeurs. 
 Mettre en œuvre la surveillance, la journalisation, l’alerte et le signalement des SLA. 
 Créer et maintenir une documentation technique. 
 Mettre en œuvre, maintenir et faire évoluer les meilleures pratiques SRE. 
 Agir comme commandant d’incident lors des incidents; coordonner la réponse interéquipes, gérer les communications et assurer une restauration rapide des services. 
 Autres exigences : 
 Rotation en cas d’escalade d’incidents
 Voyages occasionnels (visites trimestrielles sur les lieux, conférences - moins de 10 %)
 Ce que vous apportez 
 Solide expérience pertinente en ingénierie de la fiabilité des sites (SRE), en infonuagique ou en DevOps dans des environnements SaaS ou de production à grande échelle
 Solide expérience avec AWS (multicomptes, VPC, EC2, EKS) et Kubernetes à grande échelle
 Expertise pratique de l'infrastructure en tant que code et des outils d'automatisation (Terraform, Ansible ou équivalent)
 Expérience des pipelines CI/CD et de l'automatisation des mises en production (GitLab de préférence, Jenkins acceptable)
 Maîtrise des outils de surveillance et d'observabilité (Datadog ou équivalent), y compris les métriques, la journalisation, les alertes et les tableaux de bord
 Expérience de la conception, du déploiement et de l'exploitation de systèmes distribués à grande échelle et de plateformes multifournisseurs
 Solide expérience de la gestion des incidents, y compris les rotations de garde, les escalades et les analyses post-incident
 Solides compétences en scriptage avec Python, Bash, Java ou un langage semblable pour l'automatisation et le diagnostic
 Connaissance des outils d'ingénierie assistés par l'IA (p. ex. Amazon Kiro) et capacité à valider efficacement leurs résultats
 Connaissances de base des environnements de développement Java ou .NET
 Attitude proactive, avec un sens marqué de la responsabilisation, de la résolution de problèmes et du partage des connaissances
 Disposition à participer aux rotations de garde et à se déplacer occasionnellement au bureau (moins de 10 %)
 La maitrise de l’anglais écrit et parlé, essentielle pour communiquer efficacement avec des clients, fournisseurs, partenaires d’affaires et collègues situés à l’extérieur du Québec. 
 Pourquoi vous allez adorer travailler ici 
 Flexibilité axée sur le télétravail et la confiance nécessaire pour gérer votre propre horaire
 Avantages sociaux et vacances dès le premier jour
 Régime de retraite avec cotisation concurrentielle de l'employeur
 Événements pour les employés et initiatives communautaires 
 Possibilités d'apprentissage , de développement et de nouveaux défis
 Collaboration avec des équipes internationales 
  Nous favorisons un milieu de travail inclusif où chacun se sent valorisé, respecté et outillé pour s'épanouir.
  Si ce rôle correspond à ce que vous recherchez, postulez dès aujourd'hui. Si vous n'êtes pas activement à la recherche d'un emploi mais souhaitez en savoir plus, il nous fera plaisir d'échanger avec vous.
 Postulez dès aujourd'hui et découvrez ce que vous pourriez bâtir, résoudre et accomplir chez Tecsys!
 #LI-TECSYS

Aidez-nous à redéfinir le service client à l’ère de l’IA. 
 La plupart des entreprises gèrent encore leur service client avec des systèmes de billetterie conçus en 2007, auxquels on a greffé l’IA après coup.
 Botpress est la plateforme d’agents IA de niveau entreprise pour le service client, conçue dans l’autre sens. Nous voulons redéfinir le quotidien des agents de soutien et tirer le meilleur de ce qu’eux seuls savent vraiment. Nous croyons au pouvoir d’agents humains qualifiés qui pilotent l’IA, plutôt qu’à une IA qui se contente de les épauler.
 Si vous voulez bâtir la plateforme de service client de l’ère de l’IA, nous cherchons les meilleurs talents pour se joindre à nous.
 À propos du poste
 Nous recrutons un(e) gestionnaire principal(e), marketing produit, qui sera responsable du récit de Botpress. Notre produit évolue plus vite que notre message. Nous avons besoin de quelqu’un pour trouver les histoires que nos acheteurs veulent entendre, les écrire et les diffuser partout où un prospect décide si Botpress lui convient.
 Vous relèverez du directeur de la croissance produit et travaillerez directement avec la vice-présidente marketing sur le récit du produit et de l’entreprise. Vous ferez partie d’une équipe de croissance produit avec un(e) PM et un(e) ingénieur(e) croissance, pour que vos messages soient déployés rapidement et se reflètent dans l’entonnoir en quelques semaines. Chaque mot vous appartiendra, de la première publicité jusqu’à la conversion payante, et vous verrez l’effet de vos textes sur les revenus.
 Responsabilités
 Mener des entrevues clients, des études de marché et des analyses de gains et de pertes, puis transformer ces apprentissages en positionnement et en messages
 Bâtir un nouveau récit pour le produit et l’entreprise, et le déployer sur la page d’accueil, la page d’atterrissage sur le service client IA, l’accueil des nouveaux utilisateurs, la présentation commerciale et les courriels
 Attirer davantage d’acheteurs ciblés (responsables du service client B2B en Amérique du Nord) et améliorer la conversion de la page d’atterrissage à l’inscription, puis au forfait payant, en appuyant chaque changement sur des expérimentations
 Refaire les parcours de maturation et de conversion dans HubSpot, déclenchés par des signaux produit et gérés comme un programme d’expérimentation continu
 Piloter les messages et le soutien au lancement pour les changements de tarification et d’offre
 Outiller l’équipe des ventes avec des messages qu’elle utilise vraiment : présentations, positionnement concurrentiel, réponses aux objections
 Travailler avec l’équipe produit pour rattacher chaque nouvelle fonctionnalité à une proposition de valeur claire
 Votre profil
 Rédacteur(-trice) et conteur(-euse) B2B exceptionnel(le), avec un portfolio de messages publiés (pages d’accueil, lancements, pages d’atterrissage) liés à des résultats d’affaires
 Vous avez positionné ou repositionné un produit dans une jeune entreprise ou lors d’un pivot. Vous avez créé le récit plutôt que d’hériter d’une marque bien établie
 Axé(e) sur la recherche : vous menez vous-même des entrevues clients et des études de marché, et pouvez montrer comment vos constats sont devenus des messages
 Autonome dans l’exécution : vous créez et publiez vous-même vos courriels, vos parcours et vos mises à jour de pages dans HubSpot, sans équipe derrière vous
 À l’aise avec l’ambiguïté et les changements de cap rapides
 Vous pouvez nous dire quel effet vos textes ont eu sur un indicateur
 Expérience dans l’IA, le service client, l’expérience client ou les outils de centre d’assistance (p. ex. Intercom, Zendesk, Gorgias, Ada, Front)
 Expérience en marketing auprès de responsables du service client ou du soutien dans des entreprises nord-américaines de taille moyenne
 Expérience d’un entonnoir PLG ou libre-service où le marketing était responsable de la conversion, pas seulement des prospects
 Tests A/B sur des pages d’atterrissage et des courriels, et aisance avec l’analytique produit (PostHog ou l’équivalent)
 Expérience de lancement de changements de tarification et d’offre
 Pratique de Webflow ou d’un autre CMS
 Utilisation intensive et aisée des outils d’IA dans votre propre travail
 Notre processus comprend un exercice pratique rémunéré, d’une durée limitée.

 Botpress a conclu une ronde de financement de série B de 25 M$ en 2025. Nous bâtissons la plateforme d’agents IA de niveau entreprise pour le service client, non pas en ajoutant de l’IA à une vieille infrastructure, mais en misant sur l’IA dès le premier jour.

Chez Botpress, chaque personne est propriétaire de son travail et y apporte son point de vue et ses talents uniques. Nous recrutons délibérément des gens motivés, passionnés, talentueux et avides d’apprendre et de grandir tout au long de leur carrière.
 Nous travaillons entièrement au bureau, dans une culture qui valorise autant la rigueur technique que l’ambition commune.

En vous joignant à nous, vous changerez la façon dont des millions de clients interagissent avec les entreprises avec lesquelles ils font affaire, et vous bâtirez la plateforme qui définira la prochaine ère du service client.

Are you looking for a part-time job that makes a difference in your community? 
 If so, join our team! Enjoy a work-life balance, meet new people, and be a part of a team of On-Call Crossing Guards who love their jobs - some have worked as OSC Crossing Guards for 20 years (and counting!)!
 On-Call crossing guards must have their own vehicle.

 On-Call crossing guards must be available daily for all shifts, Mon-Fri. 
 Here's what you'll do as a Crossing Guard 
 Crossing Guards cover shifts at the morning school bell times for student arrival, lunchtime bells and afternoon school bell times for student dismissal. Crossing Guards are responsible for ensuring that children travelling to and from school pass safely through their assigned crossing. Crossing Guards are safety figures and are important and engaged members of the community that keep our children safe.
 Here are the specific job duties: 
 Direct and escort pedestrians across the street, stopping traffic as necessary.
 Communicate traffic, crossing rules, and other information to students and adults.
 Report unsafe student behaviour to school officials.
 Inspect your intersection on a daily basis and report any unsafe conditions.
 Monitor traffic flow to locate safe gaps through which pedestrians can cross. Create safe gaps in high traffic situations by asserting your authority to stop traffic.
 Be aware of emergency vehicles approaching the area and ensure that they have priority over vehicular and pedestrian traffic.

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
 Get to know the team
 The Developer Platform team at Auth0 (an Okta company) owns the platform that developers build identity on. Increasingly they build alongside AI agents, and that raises the bar on everything underneath: interfaces have to hold up whether a person or an agent is calling them, and the systems behind them have to stay reliable and coherent as usage grows. We move fast, we own problems end to end, and we care deeply about the platform we put in front of the developers and agents who depend on it.
 The opportunity
 We're hiring a Principal Engineer (P5) to serve as the technical leader and compass for the Developer Platform team. You'll work across the breadth of the platform, tackling the highly complex, vaguely specified problems that span it and turning them into clear technical direction the team can execute against, without day-to-day oversight. Above all, you'll own how the platform is architected to scale: the distributed systems behind it, the reliability and consistency guarantees developers depend on, and the coherence that keeps it easy to build on as usage grows. You'll champion the team's technical execution, raise the engineering bar, mentor the people around you, and partner with tech leads across teams to keep the wider platform aligned. You'll have real influence over how our platform holds up in a world where developers and agents are both first-class consumers.
 What you'll be doing
 Own the platform architecture: Set the technical direction for the developer platform, and make the cross-cutting decisions that keep it coherent and easy to build on as it grows.
 Architect for scale: Design the distributed systems behind the platform for throughput, reliability, and consistency, so the guarantees developers depend on hold up under real load.
 Turn ambiguity into direction: Take the hardest, most vaguely specified platform problems and turn them into clear, modular technical designs the team can execute against.
 Design for developers and agents: Shape the platform so it holds up whether a person or an agent is calling it, and so both can build and automate their work against Auth0.
 Raise the engineering bar: Set the standard for how the team designs, builds, and operates the platform, and lead deep, constructive reviews that grow the engineers around you.
 Partner across teams: Operate peer-to-peer with tech leads in adjacent groups to review major architectural decisions and keep the wider platform aligned.
 What you'll bring
 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record as a Principal or Staff level individual contributor.
 Distributed architecture depth: Extensive experience designing and operating high-scale, reliable backend and event-driven systems, with a strong grasp of the tradeoffs in throughput, consistency, and failure handling.
 Platform thinking: A track record of designing and shipping platforms or developer-facing systems at scale, with an instinct for the interfaces and abstractions that keep them coherent as they grow.
 IAM platform thinking: Deep understanding of identity and access management, with a sense for the platform capabilities and abstractions that make identity easier for developers to build on.
 Ownership in ambiguity: You can own vaguely specified problems and drive them to a clear technical direction without heavy top-down scoping.
 Strong engineering fundamentals: Strong Node.js fundamentals; Go a plus.
 Agent-aware design: Hands-on familiarity with agentic tooling, MCP, or LLM-facing design, and a sense for how agents consume a platform.
 Cross-functional collaboration: Experience working across engineering, product, and architecture in a fast-moving environment, and a habit of raising the bar for the people around you.
 Extra credit
 Work with agent frameworks, AI-facing systems, or developer toolchains in the LLM space.
 A background at a company where developers are the primary customer.
 Experience setting technical direction for a platform that other engineering teams build on.

 Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. This role blends program strategy, campaign execution, analytics, experimentation, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver measurable customer impact at scale.

Reporting into the Senior Manager, Digital Customer Success, this is a remote role within North America.



How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.



What we're looking for:

 - Demonstrated success building and owning lifecycle or digital success programs with measurable business impact.

 - Strong understanding of the customer lifecycle, including onboarding, activation, adoption, retention, expansion, renewal, and risk management motions.

What you can expect:

 - Identify customer signals, behaviors, milestones, and friction points that indicate progress, risk, or opportunity across the lifecycle.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.



Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.



This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.


Our approach to work

À propos de nous 
 Side est un fournisseur mondial de services et de développement de jeux vidéo. Nous offrons des services techniques et créatifs à plusieurs des plus grands développeurs et studios au monde. Fondée au Japon en 1994, PTW est devenue une force mondiale dans l’industrie du jeu vidéo, avec plus de 40 studios dans 14 pays et des bureaux en Amérique du Nord, en Europe, en Amérique du Sud et en Asie. Nos services de premier plan comprennent la production artistique, le développement de jeux, l’assurance qualité, le soutien aux joueurs, la gestion de communauté, la localisation, l’assurance qualité de la localisation, la production audio et la collecte de données. La famille de marques Side comprend Ghostpunch Games et 1518 Studios. Pour en savoir plus, visitez https://www.side.inc/ 
 L’occasion 
 Nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne pour occuper le poste de gestionnaire des finances à Montréal, au Québec. Cette personne sera responsable de la gestion financière de nos studios de livraison basés aux États-Unis et prendra en charge l’ensemble du processus de clôture mensuelle. En plus d’assurer l’exactitude de la clôture mensuelle et des rapports financiers, la personne titulaire du poste agira comme partenaire d’affaires auprès des directeurs de studio. Le rôle comprend la tenue de livres, la clôture mensuelle, la préparation des états financiers, la production et l’analyse de rapports financiers et de gestion, ainsi que la collaboration avec les membres de l’équipe des finances situés dans différents emplacements. 
 Ce que vous ferez : 
 Clôture mensuelle et production de rapports financiers 
 Diriger les activités quotidiennes de clôture mensuelle, y compris la facturation aux clients, les paiements aux fournisseurs, les rapprochements bancaires et les rapprochements de comptes. 
 Préparer et réviser les écritures de journal, les comptes du bilan, la trésorerie, les comptes clients, les comptes fournisseurs et les transactions intersociétés. 
 Analyser les écarts, résoudre les divergences et veiller à ce que les rapports soient produits avec exactitude et dans les délais. 
 Coordonner la production mensuelle de rapports à la société mère japonaise dans les délais requis et soutenir le processus de consolidation aux États-Unis. 
 Grand livre, immobilisations et états financiers 
 Tenir à jour le grand livre dans Microsoft Dynamics 365 et veiller à ce que les données financières soient exactes et adéquatement appuyées. 
 Gérer la comptabilisation des immobilisations, y compris les calendriers d’amortissement, les écritures de journal, les acquisitions, les cessions et les dépréciations. 
 Préparer les états des résultats, les bilans et les états des flux de trésorerie conformément aux normes comptables applicables. 
 Maintenir la documentation à l’appui des écritures financières, des rapports et de la préparation aux audits. 
 Conformité, contrôles et soutien aux audits 
 Assurer la conformité aux contrôles internes, aux politiques de l’entreprise ainsi qu’aux exigences locales, étatiques, fédérales et comptables applicables. 
 Soutenir la production des déclarations réglementaires dans les délais requis et maintenir des dossiers exacts pour les dépôts obligatoires. 
 Fournir la documentation et les explications nécessaires aux demandes d’audit interne et externe. 
 Examiner les données de paie afin d’en assurer l’exactitude relativement à la rémunération, aux retenues, aux calculs fiscaux et à la conformité aux politiques. 
 Partenariat d’affaires et collaboration interfonctionnelle 
 Travailler en partenariat avec les directeurs de studio aux États-Unis et les équipes des opérations afin d’harmoniser les dépenses, d’expliquer les résultats financiers et de soutenir la prise de décision. 
 Collaborer avec les membres de l’équipe des finances dans différents emplacements, y compris le comptable responsable de la consolidation et de l’information financière aux États-Unis ainsi que l’équipe de consolidation du groupe à Londres. 
 Travailler avec l’équipe de planification et d’analyse financières à Londres sur les prévisions mensuelles, les budgets trimestriels et la planification budgétaire annuelle. 
 Coordonner avec la trésorerie du groupe la prévision de trésorerie hebdomadaire et mensuelle. 
 Amélioration des processus et excellence opérationnelle 
 Repérer les occasions d’améliorer le processus de clôture mensuelle, l’exactitude des rapports et l’ensemble des flux de travail financiers. 
 Recommander et mettre en œuvre des pratiques exemplaires qui améliorent la cohérence, l’efficacité et la gestion des échéances. 
 Renforcer la documentation, les contrôles et la communication entre les finances, les opérations des studios et les parties prenantes de l’entreprise. 
 Requirements 
 Ce que nous recherchons 
 Baccalauréat en comptabilité, en finance ou dans un domaine connexe, et/ou titre de comptable professionnel agréé, comme CPA canadien, CPA américain ou équivalent, ou être en voie d’obtenir une qualification pertinente. 
 Maîtrise des logiciels de comptabilité et des systèmes de gestion intégrés; une expérience avec Microsoft Dynamics 365 est un atout. 
 Expérience importante en comptabilité complète, idéalement au sein d’une petite ou moyenne entreprise. 
 Solide connaissance des normes comptables, comme les PCGR ou les IFRS. 
 Excellentes compétences organisationnelles, grand souci du détail et capacité à respecter des échéances serrées. 
 Esprit analytique et solides compétences en résolution de problèmes. 
 Maîtrise intermédiaire ou avancée de Microsoft Office, notamment Excel, PowerPoint et Word, avec une expertise particulière dans Excel. 
 Benefits 
 Pourquoi vous joindre à Side 
 Chez Side, vous vous joindrez à une équipe mondiale passionnée par les jeux vidéo, la technologie et les gens. Vous aurez l’occasion d’avoir une incidence concrète sur les opérations financières de nos studios américains en soutenant la production de rapports exacts, en améliorant les processus de clôture mensuelle et en collaborant avec les équipes des studios et des finances dans nos emplacements à l’échelle mondiale.
 About Us 
 Side is a global video game development and services provider, providing technical and creative services to many of the largest developers and studios around the world. Founded in Japan in 1994, PTW has grown to become a global force in the gaming industry, with over 40 studios in 14 countries worldwide and offices across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia. Our industry-leading services include art production, game development, quality assurance, player support, community management, localization, localization QA, audio production, and data collection. The Side family of brands includes Ghostpunch Games, and 1518 Studios. For more information, visit https://www.side.inc/ 
 The Opportunity 
 We are looking for a Finance Manager in Montreal, Quebec to manage our US-based delivery studios with a full skill set of monthly closing processes. While making sure monthly closing and reporting, the Finance Manager acts as a business partner for the Studio Heads. The scope of the Finance Manager role involves bookkeeping, monthly closing, preparation of financial statements, financial and management reporting & analysis, and collaboration with finance team members in different locations. 
 What You Will Do: 
 Monthly Close and Financial Reporting 
 Lead day-to-day monthly close activities, including customer billing, supplier payments, bank reconciliations, and account reconciliations. 
 Prepare and review journal entries, balance sheet accounts, cash, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and intercompany transactions. 
 Analyze variances, resolve discrepancies, and ensure reporting is completed accurately and on time. 
 Coordinate timely monthly reporting to the Japanese parent company and support the US consolidation process. 
 General Ledger, Fixed Assets, and Financial Statements 
 Maintain the general ledger in Microsoft Dynamics 365 and ensure financial data is accurate and properly supported. 
 Manage fixed asset accounting, including depreciation schedules, journal entries, purchases, disposals, and impairments. 
 Prepare income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements in line with applicable accounting standards. 
 Maintain documentation that supports financial entries, reporting, and audit readiness. 
 Compliance, Controls, and Audit Support 
 Ensure compliance with internal controls, company policies, and applicable local, state, federal, and accounting requirements. 
 Support timely regulatory filings and maintain accurate records for required submissions. 
 Provide documentation and explanations for internal and external audit requests. 
 Review payroll data for accuracy in compensation, deductions, tax calculations, and policy compliance. 
 Business Partnership and Cross-Functional Collaboration 
 Partner with US Studio Heads and operations teams to align expenses, explain financial results, and support decision-making. 
 Collaborate with finance team members across locations, including the US consolidation/financial accountant and group consolidation team in London. 
 Work with the London FP&A team on monthly forecasts, quarterly budgets, and annual budget planning. 
 Coordinate with Group Treasury on weekly and monthly cash forecasting. 
 Process Improvement and Operational Excellence 
 Identify opportunities to improve the monthly close process, reporting accuracy, and overall finance workflows. 
 Recommend and implement best practices that improve consistency, efficiency, and deadline management. 
 Strengthen documentation, controls, and communication across finance, studio operations, and corporate stakeholders. 
 What We Are Looking For 
 Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, and/or Qualified Accountant (Canadian CA/CPAUS CPA or equivalent)/actively pursuing qualification. 
 Proficiency in accounting software and ERP systems (experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is a plus). 
 Significant end-to-end accounting experience within a small to midsized company is preferred 
 Strong knowledge of accounting standards such as GAAP or IFRS. 
 Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to meet tight deadlines. 
 Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills. 
 Intermediate or above of MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), Excel in particular. 
 Why Join Side 
 At Side, you'll join a global team passionate about games, technology, and people. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the financial operations of our US studios by supporting accurate reporting, improving monthly close processes, and partnering with studio and finance teams across our global locations.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

This position sits within Ramp’s Channel team and reports to Partner Consulting. In this role, you’ll build and scale Ramp’s long-term System Integrator (SI)-led implementation program. You’ll enable a broad ecosystem of implementation partners to support a meaningful volume of Ramp-referred customers, deliver high-quality implementations, and extend the capacity of Ramp’s Customer Success organization.

 

Ramp’s current SI pilot is the starting point - not the end state. You’ll translate the pilot’s learnings into the operating model, technical readiness, commercial foundations, and quality controls required to scale responsibly from an initial cohort to a broad network of partners across products, ERP ecosystems, and geographies.

 

You’ll be Ramp’s technical and programmatic owner for SI delivery: enabling partners to implement Ramp successfully, defining clear scope and certification standards, measuring implementation quality and customer outcomes, and turning field learnings into improvements across product, enablement, and partner strategy.

À propos de Mila 
 Fondé par le professeur Yoshua Bengio de l’Université de Montréal, Mila rassemble des chercheurs spécialisés en intelligence artificielle et plus précisément en apprentissage automatique, apprentissage profond et apprentissage par renforcement. Reconnu mondialement pour ses importantes contributions au domaine de l’apprentissage profond, Mila s’est particulièrement distingué dans la modélisation du langage, la traduction automatique, la reconnaissance d’objets et les modèles génératifs. Depuis 2017, Mila est le fruit d’une collaboration entre l’Université de Montréal et l’Université McGill, en lien étroit avec Polytechnique Montréal et HEC Montréal.
 Mila s’est donné pour mission d’être un pôle mondial d’avancées scientifiques qui inspire l’innovation et l’essor de l’intelligence artificielle (IA) au bénéfice de tous.
 Pour en connaitre davantage, veuillez consulter https://mila.quebec/ 
 Sommaire du poste
 Le Lab d'IA souveraine est une nouvelle initiative de Mila visant à assembler une pile (un stack)  d'inférence IA open source prête pour l'entreprise, que les organisations peuvent déployer et exploiter sur des infrastructures sous leur contrôle. Elle combine le service de modèles, la recherche d'information (RAG), l'orchestration d'agents et l'observabilité, avec un plan de contrôle pour les gérer comme un produit unique.
 Sous la responsabilité du directeur principal de l'ingénierie logicielle, vous concevrez et maintiendrez les paquets de déploiement et l'automatisation de la pile d'IA. Ceux-ci permettront aux partenaires de déployer, mettre à jour et restaurer la pile sur leur propre infrastructure, depuis un nœud unique jusqu'à des grappes Kubernetes en production. Vous travaillerez avec l'équipe d'intégration pour paqueter leurs composants et les déployer dans des environnements de référence à l'aide de flux de travail partagés. Vous recommandez des technologies de plateforme sur la base de tests reproductibles, d'exigences opérationnelles et de la pertinence de l'architecture. Ce rôle ne comprend pas de support de production ni de garde (on-call).
 La réussite de ce rôle signifie que les partenaires peuvent déployer, mettre à jour, restaurer et exploiter la pile de manière autonome dans des environnements pris en charge, à l'aide d'automatismes et de guides d'utilisation (runbooks) vérifiés.
 Principales responsabilités
 Évaluer les composants de chaque couche de la pile. Développer une connaissance approfondie de leurs capacités, de leurs limites et de leur adéquation avec l'architecture.
 Tester les composants candidats par des expérimentations, des bancs d'essai reproductibles et des déploiements pilotes. Documenter les méthodes et les résultats pour appuyer les décisions techniques.
 Collaborer avec le responsable technique pour recommander des composants et des approches d'intégration basés sur les résultats de tests, les besoins du projet et les exigences opérationnelles.
 Intégrer les composants sélectionnés en production via de la configuration et des tests d'interopérabilité. Effectuer à l'occasion des contributions en amont (upstream) ou rédiger de petits conteneurs d'accompagnement (sidecars) d'intégration au besoin.
 Concevoir et maintenir les flux de travail CI pour tester l'intégration des composants. Automatiser la configuration, le déploiement, les mises à jour et la restauration à l'aide de flux de travail de livraison partagés.
 S'assurer que les composants attribués respectent les exigences de sécurité, d'observabilité et du plan de contrôle.
 Soutenir les déploiements pilotes, diagnostiquer les pannes et améliorer la fiabilité, les performances et l'efficacité des ressources. Travailler avec l'ingénieur·e plateforme sur les modifications d'infrastructure nécessaires.
 Maintenir la documentation d'intégration, les enregistrements de bancs d'essai, les guides d'utilisation (runbooks) et les instructions d'exploitation afin que les ingénieurs et les organisations pilotes puissent déployer et exploiter les composants de manière autonome.

 About Mila 
 Founded by Professor Yoshua Bengio of the Université de Montréal, Mila brings together researchers specializing in artificial intelligence, and more specifically in machine learning, deep learning and reinforcement learning. Recognized worldwide for its important contributions to the field of deep learning, Mila has particularly distinguished itself in language modeling, machine translation, object recognition and generative models. Since 2017, Mila has been the fruit of a collaboration between Université de Montréal and McGill University, with close links to Polytechnique Montréal and HEC Montréal.
 Mila's mission is to be a global hub of scientific advances that inspires innovation and the rise of artificial intelligence (AI) for the benefit of all.
 To find out more, please visit https://mila.quebec/ 
 Position Summary
 The Sovereign AI Lab is a new Mila initiative to assemble an enterprise-ready, open-source AI inference stack that organizations can deploy and operate on infrastructure they control. It combines model serving, retrieval, agent orchestration, and observability, with a control plane to operate them as one product.
 Reporting to the Senior Director of Engineering, you will build and maintain deployment packages and automation for the stack. They will enable partners to deploy, upgrade, and roll back the stack on their own infrastructure, from a single node to production Kubernetes clusters. You will work with the integration team to package their components and deploy them to reference environments through shared workflows. You will recommend platform technologies based on reproducible tests, operational requirements, and architecture fit. This role does not include production support or on-call duty.
 Success means partners can deploy, upgrade, roll back, and operate the stack independently in supported environments, using verified automation and runbooks.

 Build and maintain CI workflows to test component integrations. Automate configuration, deployment, upgrades, and rollback through shared release workflows.
 Ensure assigned components meet security, observability, and control plane requirements.
 Support pilot deployments, diagnose failures, and improve reliability, performance, and resource efficiency. Work with the Platform Engineer on required infrastructure changes.
 Maintain integration documentation, benchmark records, runbooks, and operating instructions so engineers and pilot organizations can deploy and operate components independently.

 Expérience pratique de l'intégration et des tests d'au moins un composant d'IA, comme un système de recherche d'information ou de mémoire, un environnement d'exécution d'agents, un serveur ou une passerelle de modèles, un serveur d'outils, ou un registre de modèles ou d'outils.

 Capacité à expliquer des compromis techniques et à rédiger une documentation permettant à d'autres équipes de déployer et d'exploiter les composants de manière autonome.
 Expérience souhaitable

 Required Qualifications

 Hands-on experience integrating and testing at least one AI component, such as a retrieval or memory system, agent runtime, model server or gateway, tool server, or model or tool registry.

About AI Acquisition 
 AI Acquisition is a bootstrapped, multi-entity business helping founders and operators scale with AI. We combine SaaS platforms, consulting, and a full sales and delivery engine. We manage thousands of active clients across multiple products and operate globally.
 The Role 
 You're taking over an existing book of established client relationships. These are not new clients figuring out what they bought. They've been with us, they know the product, and they have expectations built on months of experience with the business.
 Your job is to keep them progressing, keep them retained, and keep them expanding. That means understanding where each client actually is in their business, what's working, what's stuck, and what they need next. Not checking in for the sake of it. Actually moving the needle on their results.
 This is a consulting role disguised as account management. You're not managing a spreadsheet of renewals. You're advising business owners on how to grow: how to frame their offer, how to think about their funnel, how to close deals, how to handle fulfillment, and how to use AI to do all of it faster.
 The clients you inherit will have history, context, and in some cases, frustrations that predate you. Your first job is to audit that book, understand every account's real status, and earn trust through competence rather than promises.
 What You'll Own 
 An established portfolio of legacy clients across various stages of maturity and engagement
 Regular check-ins, growth workshops, and strategic conversations with business owners who are building and scaling real companies
 Client retention — spotting risk before it becomes a refund conversation, re-engaging clients who've gone quiet, and resolving issues without escalation
 Business consulting — advising clients on offer framing, lead generation strategy, sales process, prospecting, closing, and fulfillment. You need to understand these well enough to coach, not just relay information
 Upsell identification — knowing when a client is ready for more and positioning the next step as the natural move, not a sales pitch
 Cross-functional coordination with the onboarding, deliverables, and office hours teams to make sure nothing falls through the cracks
 Documentation — every interaction, decision, and next step logged so anyone picking up your account knows exactly where things stand
 What We Need From You 
 Native or near-native English fluency is non-negotiable. You will be on camera with clients daily and every conversation needs to land with clarity and confidence
 Direct experience as a CSM, account manager, or business consultant where you personally advised clients on how to start, grow, or scale a business. Not just managed the relationship, actually consulted on the business itself
 You understand the mechanics of lead generation, sales funnels, cold email, LinkedIn outreach, and how they connect to a client's revenue. You don't need to execute campaigns yourself but you need to diagnose why one isn't converting and coach the client through it
 You've managed a portfolio of clients where retention and expansion were your responsibility, not someone else's
 You're comfortable with difficult conversations. Clients who are frustrated, clients who are stuck, clients who need honest feedback about their own execution. You handle these with composure and directness
 You come with solutions, not just problems. When something breaks in a client's journey, your instinct is to propose the fix, not report the issue and wait
 You pick things up fast. The biggest challenge for external hires in this role has been the knowledge gap — there is a lot to learn about our products, processes, and client journeys, and you need to absorb it quickly enough to be credible in front of clients within weeks, not months
 You're comfortable with AI tools and either already use them in your work or will learn without being told to
 This Is Not For You If 
 You only know relationship management without the business consulting layer. "Keeping clients happy" is not the job. Moving their business forward is
 You need months to ramp before you can have a real conversation with a client. Our clients won't wait that long
 You're uncomfortable advising business owners on sales, prospecting, or offer strategy. That's a core part of the role, not a nice-to-have
 You avoid hard conversations or tell clients what they want to hear instead of what they need to hear
 You wait to be told what's wrong rather than finding it yourself
 What Success Looks Like 
 Your clients are progressing, not just retained. Business results, not just satisfaction scores
 Clients at risk are flagged and handled before they escalate. You're the person who prevents the refund conversation, not the one having it
 You've audited your book within the first two weeks and can articulate every client's real status, not what's in the notes
 You're coaching clients on their business, not just updating them on deliverables
 You pick up the product knowledge fast enough to be credible in front of clients by week three
 You adopt new tools and processes without being chased
 The Environment 
 This is a high-performance, remote-first team at the cutting edge of AI-powered business building.
 Direct access to department heads from day one
 Strong performers progress quickly based on what they deliver, not tenure
 Exposure to AI-led systems and tools daily
 Autonomy and ownership over your portfolio
 A team that holds a high bar and expects the same from everyone
 This role operates as an independent contractor engagement: invoice-based, permanent structure, regulated notice periods on both sides. We expect 50 to 60 hours a week from our best people, not as a crunch but as the natural shape of work that matters.
 If you're looking for structure handed to you, this isn't the right place. If you want to be the one "Lifting the Hood", build something real, and raise the bar every week with a team that moves fast, we want to talk.

About the Team 
 The Merchant is at the core of DoorDash. The Merchant Team, one of the largest in the company, powers many facets of our business and is one of the primary drivers of growth and revenue. On the Merchant Strategy & Ops team, our mission is to have best-in class restaurant selection, build cutting edge services for our merchants to grow their business, and help our partners operate seamlessly.
 About the Role 
 We are looking for an operator with a strong bias to action who loves using data and getting creative to solve problems. You’ll join our Merchant Selection team, where we operate relentlessly towards ensuring we strike the best possible deals with our merchants, to enable us to grow our restaurant selection in a sustainable manner. 
 Selection’s north star is simply to ensure we have the best & most restaurant offering in each neighbourhood we operate in. It sounds simple enough…but of course in practice it’s much more complicated than that. 
 Retention is part of Selection because we believe that signing a merchant isn’t enough. It all means nothing if we churn the merchant a few months later (either poached by a competitor to go exclusive, or the merchant has had a bad experience and chooses to leave…both are equally bad). Since selection is measured on all merchants on the platform meaning we need to acquire + retain as many merchants as possible. It’s also our job to make sure that we’re retaining merchants in a way that not only aligns with our business priorities, but in a way that we can afford.
 Your role here is to critically analyze new and existing partnerships and help us sign/retain our partners either proactively or reactively (i.e., a churn threat or a competitor exclusivity takeover). To do so, you’ll get deep in the data, evaluate renegotiation deals and determine if the requested terms are financially feasible. We need to create the right amount of ‘friction’ to push for the best possible deal. Sometimes we have to hold firm and reject deals, other times we accept deals that may fall outside our WTP. We don’t always get it right, because there is both a science (financial modeling) and an art (intel from the field or strategic decisions) to deal desk and it really just takes multiple reps to get comfortable owning these approvals.
 You’re excited about this opportunity because you will… 
 Strategize – Devise and execute initiatives against the overall Selection strategy, focused on how we can get the most out of our agreements with merchants
 Optimize – Build the best merchant revenue engine so DoorDash continues to offer the highest quality selection for its customers and retain our merchants 
 Partner: You love equipping other teams with what they need to be successful. You are able to take feedback and put it into action. 
 We’re excited about you because you have… 
 5+ years of experience in consulting, strategy, finance, analytics or business operations experience
 Financial modelling experience is required 
 A proven track record of analytical problem solving, managing cross-functional initiatives and stake-holders, and succeeding in a fast moving environment
 An analytical mindset and can deliver actionable recommendations out of complex datasets; SQL experience is preferred
 Bachelors Degree or higher
 Why You’ll Love Working at DoorDash

 We are doers - We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions that will lead our company and our industry is what we do -- on every project, every day. 
 We are learners - We’re not afraid to dig in and uncover the truth, even if it’s scary or inconvenient. Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we’ve been in a role for one year or one minute.
 We are customer-obsessed - Our mission is to grow and empower local economies. We are committed to our customers, merchants, and dashers and believe in connecting people with possibility.
 We are all DoorDash - The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.

 Compensation

About Behavox: 
 Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world. 
 From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise. 
 Our approach is unique, and it’s validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are. 
 We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before. 
 This is a hybrid role with 1 day in the office. 
 About the Role: 
 The Senior HR Business Partner is an individual contributor responsible for partnering with US and Canada business leaders to execute people strategies that support organizational performance and growth. 
 The role applies strong business acumen and HR expertise to advise leaders on workforce planning, performance management, employee relations, and organizational effectiveness within the US and Canada client group, and covers this territory directly and in full. 
 Reporting to the Principal HR Business Partner, the Senior HR Business Partner partners with leaders to deliver people initiatives while ensuring alignment with global frameworks and applicable US and Canada employment requirements. 
 During the initial phase of the role, the Senior HR Business Partner works under close coaching from the Principal HR Business Partner while building full ownership of the client group; oversight reduces as competence across the remit is demonstrated. 
 The role supports workforce planning, organizational design, and post-merger workforce integration workstreams for its client group, executes assigned enterprise HR programs and projects, and independently manages moderate-to-complex employee relations matters, escalating matters of significant complexity, cross-jurisdictional exposure, or elevated organizational risk to the Principal HR Business Partner. 
 It uses workforce data and people metrics to inform recommendations for its client group, and may be asked to support the Principal HR Business Partner on workforce matters outside the US and Canada as the function's footprint grows. 
 What You'll Bring: 
 HR Business Partnering — Applies working knowledge of business priorities and workforce needs within the US and Canada client group to align people initiatives with business objectives and provide trusted advisory support to leaders and managers at all levels. 
 Workforce Planning and Organizational Support — Applies workforce planning methodologies and organizational design principles to support headcount planning, org changes, and business effectiveness within the client group, in line with the framework set by the Principal HR Business Partner. 
 Employment Law and Employee Relations (US & Canada) — Maintains working knowledge of US and Canadian employment legislation and regulatory frameworks, independently managing moderate-to-complex employee relations matters within those jurisdictions. Working knowledge of employment fundamentals in other jurisdictions (e.g., UK, EMEA, APAC) is desirable, as the role may be asked to support the wider HR Business Partner team outside its core territory. 
 Talent Management and Performance — Applies performance management, career development, and talent process knowledge to support capability development within the client group. 
 People Analytics — Uses workforce metrics, organizational data, and HRIS-derived reporting to evaluate trends and support evidence-based decisions within the client group. 
 What You'll Do: 
 HR Advisory — Provides sound, commercially informed HR guidance to leaders on moderate-to-complex workforce and talent challenges within the US and Canada client group, exercising judgment on approach and escalating matters that exceed this level's scope. 
 Employee Relations Case Management — Manages moderate-to-complex employee relations cases end-to-end within US and Canada employment frameworks, balancing legal compliance, business priorities, and employee experience. 
 People Program Delivery — Delivers and locally adapts HR programs (performance cycles, workforce planning inputs, career development processes) for the client group in line with enterprise standards. 
 Workforce Data Interpretation — Interprets workforce data and people metrics for the client group to identify trends and inform recommendations to leaders, including through periods of increased organizational scrutiny or governance rigor (e.g., audit readiness, compliance program maturation, or a prior employer's scale-up or pre-exit period). 
 Compensation Analysis — Applies compensation data and benchmarking to support pay recommendations, offer construction, and pay equity considerations for the client group, escalating matters requiring Principal-level or Total Rewards review. 
 What We Offer 
 The opportunity to work on a global, mission-critical AI platform alongside the best engineers and technologists across multiple geographies 
 A role with real ownership and impact, building complex systems at scale in an environment that values speed, experimentation, and technical excellence 
 A highly attractive benefits package, including competitive cash compensation, an equity award aligned with long-term value creation, and comprehensive health insurance for employees and their families 
 Modern, comfortable offices in Montreal/Toronto downtown, with an expectation of (hybrid) working from the office 1 day per week, reflecting our belief in strong in-person collaboration. 
 A generous time-off policy of 30 days annually, plus public holidays and sick leave, recognizing the importance of sustained high performance 
 About Our Process 
 We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment. 
 During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies. 
 The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible. 
 Please note that: 
 We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification from the process. 
 Interviews may be recorded for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.

Are you looking for a part-time job that makes a difference in your community? If so, join our team! Enjoy a work-life balance, meet new people, and be a part of a team of Crossing Guards who love their jobs - some have worked as OSC Crossing Guards for 20 years (and counting!)! 
 Shifts range from 1hr and 5 minutes to 2.5 hours, during the morning, lunch and afternoon school bell times, Monday to Friday. 
 Here's what you'll do as a Crossing Guard 
 Crossing Guards cover shifts at the morning school bell times for student arrival, lunchtime bells and afternoon school bell times for student dismissal. Crossing Guards are responsible for ensuring that children travelling to and from school pass safely through their assigned crossing. Crossing Guards are safety figures and are important and engaged members of the community that keep our children safe. 
 Here are the specific job duties: 
 Direct and escort pedestrians across the street, stopping traffic as necessary.
 Communicate traffic, crossing rules, and other information to students and adults.
 Report unsafe student behaviour to school officials.
 Inspect your intersection on a daily basis and report any unsafe conditions.
 Monitor traffic flow to locate safe gaps through which pedestrians can cross. Create safe gaps in high traffic situations by asserting your authority to stop traffic. 
 Be aware of emergency vehicles approaching the area and ensure that they have priority over vehicular and pedestrian traffic.
 CLICK HERE to see a map of all of the Crossing Guard locations that the OSC manages in Toronto!
 Here's what we need from you: 
 Recent Vulnerable Sector Police Records Check (PRC) (To be completed after the interview process. Costs are reimbursed by the OSC. Employment offer conditional upon a negative VSC).
 Apply ONLINE for a PRC using the directions below: 
 1) Use the following link to apply online www.tps.to/police-checks 
 2) The online application will ask you for a program number. When prompted, input the following: Program Number: 202309TPSONECB84
The OSC will reimburse you for the costs of the PRC after 3 months of employment . If the costs are prohibitive, please let us know ASAP. Your offer of employment is conditional upon a completed PRC - Level 3 - Vulnerable Police Record Check. 
 Effective verbal and listening communication skills in English
 Ability to interact and cooperate with people of diverse ages and backgrounds
 Ability to work independently and complete daily activities according to a work schedule
 Ability to walk briskly, move repeatedly in and out of the intersection, and stand for up to 1.5 hrs

 As a Computer Vision/AI Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and developing reliable, maintainable, and scalable CV systems. In this role, you’ll apply computer vision and machine learning to real-world challenges, integrating classical CV techniques and deep learning into production-ready products.

We are looking for an engineer who embraces modern AI tools as a core part of their development workflow. You should be someone who actively uses AI to accelerate software development, improve code quality, troubleshoot problems, automate repetitive work and increase your overall engineering leverage.

 Collaborate with product managers to translate real-world challenges into practical CV/ML solutions that create a measurable impact
 Design and develop computer vision and vision-language solutions using both classical techniques and modern AI approaches

 Our Values

About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.



Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.



Our vision



We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.



But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.



Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.



In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.



Our traction



Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com http://Owner.com website.



More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.



Our team



Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.



We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.



Where we work



Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!





Why we’re looking for you



Lighthouse is Owner’s multi-location and scale initiative — the next chapter for customers who’ve experienced hyper-growth on the core platform and now need more advanced capabilities to keep scaling with us (not outgrowing us). Crucially, we do this on the one platform (not a separate “enterprise product”), so the most sophisticated features we build for multi-location brands trickle down to strengthen every single-location restaurant too — leveling the playing field by giving Davids “Goliath powers.”



We’re hiring a product leader to run Lighthouse end-to-end — a PM who wants to run and build a business line (product + operating model), and who is excited to be forward-deployed with our biggest customers. You’ll spend meaningful time in the field building relationships with sophisticated restaurant groups, and you’ll turn that signal into a scalable product + operating model. Our ambition is to start and scale a business line that can become $100M+ ARR.

This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada.



 The impact you'll have



 - Define and run the Lighthouse strategy and operating model: ICP, value prop, entitlements, and success metrics.

 - Build a differentiated Lighthouse customer experience across pre-sale, launch, and ongoing value delivery.

 - Partner tightly with Sales, Launch, Customer Success, Support, RevOps, and Engineering to keep deals moving and customers successful.

 - Drive the Lighthouse roadmap and ship multi-location capabilities into the one platform (not a fork).

 - Spend meaningful time with customers in the field and translate signal into shipped outcomes



Who you’ll work with



 - Report directly to VP Product.

 - Partner closely with leaders across Sales, Launch, CS/Support, RevOps, Marketing, and Engineering.



 What we’re looking for



 - 5+ years of Product Management experience.

 - Builder mindset — thrives in ambiguity, prototypes quickly, and learns by building.

 - Technically fluent — comfortable reading code, reasoning about systems, and partnering deeply with engineers.

 - Rapid prototyper — uses AI, SQL, Figma, no-code, or lightweight code to validate ideas and accelerate execution.

 - Strong product operator — proven track record of shipping high-impact products.

 - Customer obsessed — excels at discovery, relationship building, and translating customer needs into product direction.

 - Business-minded — understands unit economics, GTM strategy, and growth levers.

 - Cross-functional leader — aligns teams and drives decisions across engineering, design, and go-to-market.

 - Founder mentality — end-to-end ownership with an entrepreneurial approach; former founders are a strong plus.



Compensation and benefits



 - The estimated starting base salary range for this role is $275-300K, plus a generous pre-IPO equity package

 - Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, remote-first workplace, unlimited PTO - plus extra fun perks!





Notice - Employment Scams

Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address.

We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers, while providing an easy and professional customer experience.
